The Borrower will not permit the Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, as at the last day of any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters of the Borrower which period ends on or after September 30, 2022 to exceed 4.50 to 1.00.

review.note: The Acquisition Holiday raises the cap to 5.00x for four quarters after a qualifying acquisition. That is conditional on an event the language cannot express, so only the standing 4.50x threshold is recorded; if a holiday is in force the covenant is reported tighter than it is. Capital Lease Obligations are not separately reported and are omitted from the numerator, which understates net debt.
